action.prompt: Review only the file that was just saved (src/proofkit/integration/packet.py or src/proofkit/integration/reminder.py). Check exactly three things: (1) any note text, document text, quote, source_quote, platform, condition, statement or name that can reach HTML without passing through html.escape, including unsafe_allow_html with user content; (2) SMS reminder text that can exceed 160 characters or contain non-ASCII or non-printable characters, including when the first name is long or non-ASCII; (3) PHI beyond the member's first name in the SMS (last name, member_id, phone digits, conditions, ICD-10 codes, exemption type, program names, note or document text); the income shortfall amount and the due date are allowed by design. Report each finding as 'line N: problem; suggested fix'. If a check has no findings, write 'none' for it. Do not edit any file and do not run any command.
